same_region_requirement: Same frozen PDF SHA and original page plus explicit item/crop provenance or equation/source identity. Do not pair by reconstruction-text similarity alone. Unknown provenance -> no b score.
human_unit_scope: Keep W3 original50 block labels and21 source code labels. Do not copy a block error label to every constituent line/ref. Additional known algorithm case is separate supplemental stratum.
precision_recall: Report primary error-detection precision/recall on evaluable known-human-label rows; also report support(pass-as-correct) precision/recall from same confusion matrix to remove positive-class ambiguity.
unavailable_signals: UNKNOWN/NA means no decision, not a failed semantic test. Exclude unavailable features from conditional discrimination denominators; report their counts and whole-cohort verified coverage.
verified_unknown_labels: Report signal-pass items with unknown/metadata human label separately; do not hide them by computing 0% wrong only among known labels.
sample_scope: W3 near/error audit and selected live-preflight cases are not representative deployment prevalence or probability calibration. Exact binomial CIs are descriptive item-level audit intervals; correlated items and purposeful selection limit generalization.
syntax_scope: Use local latex2mathml plus actual isolated Chrome MathML render if available. Unsupported/unresolved commands are UNKNOWN, not syntax success. Conversion-only is not actual render; no TeX compiler present. Syntax success does not imply math meaning.
description_scope: Compute literal native-text agreement only if an actual aligned native-text region exists; no native chars -> NA. Literal-description agreement is not a semantic content truth criterion. b/c missing or NA remains explicit.
ROC: Risk=1-character-agreement on continuous feature; binary operator/number/syntax features report binary ROC. Do not silently select optimized threshold. Existing fixed primary .95 plus exact operators/numbers stays unchanged.
